name: SANS AI Security Maturity Model
short_description: Five-stage maturity model organized around the Protect, Utilize, Govern pillars. The operational companion to the SANS Secure AI Blueprint. This is the spine of the site.

name: OWASP AI Exchange
short_description: International open consortium publication. 300+ pages covering threats, controls, risk analysis, and agentic AI. Tagged with #CONTROL-NAME hashtags throughout.

name: NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)
short_description: Govern, Map, Measure, Manage. The NIST framework for trustworthy AI, with the Generative AI Profile (NIST AI 600-1) as an applied companion.

name: ISO/IEC 42001
short_description: AI management system standard. ISMS-style controls and certifiable management requirements for AI.

name: CSA AI Controls Matrix
short_description: Cloud Security Alliance controls matrix for AI systems. v1.1 has 247 control objectives tagged by type, applicability and ownership, architectural relevance, LLM lifecycle, and threat category, plus the AI-CAIQ self-assessment. Builds on CCM.

name: CIS Controls v8.1 (AI Companion Guides)
version: v8.1; AI LLM, AI Agents, and MCP Companion Guides (April 2026)
short_description: The 18 CIS Critical Security Controls interpreted for LLMs, AI agents, and MCP, one Companion Guide per layer. Cited here by Safeguard number. Drives the Tool Baselines section, which supplies the per-setting layer CIS does not publish for AI tools.

name: EU AI Act
short_description: EU regulation classifying AI systems by risk tier with corresponding obligations. Compliance posture rather than a control library.

name: MITRE ATLAS
short_description: Adversarial Threat Landscape for AI Systems. Threat technique taxonomy analogous to MITRE ATT&CK, oriented to ML/AI.
